relationships.subject: 7,8-Dihydroxyflavone
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, 7,8-DHF enhanced antioxidant capacity by increasing SOD/CAT activities and decreasing MDA levels, which correlated with TrkB phosphorylation, subsequent AKT/ERK pathway activation, upregulated SIRT3 expression, and MnSOD deacetylation.

relationships.subject: 7,8-Dihydroxyflavone
relationships.evidence_quote: 7,8-DHF treatment significantly decreased the prostate index, alleviated pelvic tactile allodynia, and improved bladder function in EAP mice.

key_findings: 7,8-DHF alleviates allodynia and inflammation in EAP mice via TrkB/AKT/ERK/SIRT3.
In RWPE-1 cells the protective effect depends on SIRT3.
